chapter: Country years in St. John Parish
title: Born in St. John Parish; the Magnolia Band and Casimir Matthews
summary: Phillips was born in St. John Parish, left in 1918, and played guitar in the Magnolia Band led by his cousin Casimir Matthews.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: He's 78 years old right now. 78 years? 78 years old. Well, you've got a good age already now. And were you born here in the city? No, I was born in St. John's Parish. In St. John's Parish. And when did you leave St. John's Parish?
1918. You left St. John's Parish. See? Now, what was the first kind of music you heard that you remember? Any type of music?
When I first come to the city?
No, when you first started out when you were a little boy. In the country.
In the country. Well, when I was in the country, I was playing guitar. In a band.
A band by the name of the Magnolia Band. I was playing guitar. The Magnolia. The Magnolia Band.
And, who was the leader of the band?
Well, it was a first cousin of mine. It was a young man by the name of Casimir Matthews. I was the leader.
He was the leader of the band. The Magnolia Band.
Did he have a manager, too?
Huh? Was he the manager, too? He was the manager. He was the manager? He was the violin player. He was the manager. I see.
And what towns did you play in?
